test_title: PYST 5: SSC JE EE - Reasoning (Held on: 24 March 2021 (Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is correct for the bracketed letters with respect to their inclusion in the given series.

U, G, R, L, (P), Q, L, V, I, A, F, (G)

options.text: Both the bracketed letters are correct.
The first bracketed letter is correct and the second bracketed letter is incorrect.
Both the bracketed letters are incorrect.
The first bracketed letter is incorrect and the second bracketed letter is correct.

solution:
According to the English alphabet series and its positional value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1196a07d03c9f02e7bec22cfc36a195fd3a58e076da25a1e2a394b79aea80ec7.png] 

The logic follows here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e3fc585fb009982e5421a2b9bd1b2f20bdf97a2eaecf19e66f055dc6927ea20.png] 

In place of P, it is O.

And; in place of G, it is F.

Hence, **"Both the bracketed letters are incorrect."**
